independent_computation.question: Given only cached wiki source data, what is the correct parent-ability value of `recast_of` on Syndra's synthetic `Q2` ability entry?
step_1_what_is_Syndra_Q2: data/champions.json Syndra has exactly five wiki ability slots: P (Transcendent), Q (Dark Sphere), W (Force of Will), E (Scatter the Weak), R (Unleashed Power). No champion in data/champions.json carries a raw 'Q2' key (checked all 173 entries) - 'Q2' is therefore a calculator-side synthetic slot, not a wiki slot.

The cached audit evidence names it explicitly: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json, Syndra.module_slots.note = 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)', and gap_summary = 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge'. data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json Syndra = '40+ Q charges via Q2 slot'.
So Q2 is the SECOND CAST OF DARK SPHERE unlocked by the 40-Splinter Transcendent bonus. Its damage, mana cost and recharge are Dark Sphere's - i.e. Q's.
step_2_parent_is_uniquely_Q: Wiki Q text: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'

The stocked charge is a charge OF DARK SPHERE. The only admissible parent slot for the Q2 entry is Q; P/W/E/R are ruled out by the source text (P = Splinters/AP capstone, W = Force of Will grab+throw, E = Scatter the Weak, R = Unleashed Power).
Therefore, if the field is populated at all, the only correct value is 'Q'. The new value is the unique non-null candidate the source supports.
step_3_absent_is_strictly_worse: Q's cached cooldown/recharge row is a SINGLE shared clock: cooldown = [7,7,7,7,7] (affectedByCdr false) and rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7]. Both stocked spheres draw from that one Dark Sphere recharge pool ('up to a maximum of 2' charges on one recharge timer), not from two parallel clocks.

docs/math-foundations.md Sec 1.1 (quoted below) schedules casts on ONE shared timeline with a per-ability effective cooldown c_i and cast epochs 0, c_i, 2c_i, ...  An ability entry with no declared parent is an independent ability i with its own c_i.

So leaving `recast_of` absent asserts that Q2 is an independent ability with its own 7 s clock running in parallel with Q - which would let Dark Sphere be cast twice as often as the wiki allows, indefinitely. Declaring `recast_of = 'Q'` binds the Q2 entry to Dark Sphere's own slot/clock, which is what the source text describes.
Hence: absent = wrong (implies an unbound second ability), 'Q' = correct (binds the extra cast to Dark Sphere).
step_4_caveat_on_the_word_recast: Under the LoL wiki's STRICT vocabulary, 'Recast' is an explicitly labelled follow-up of a held cast. In Syndra's kit that label appears only on W: 'Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held.' / 'Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location...'. Dark Sphere carries no 'Recast:' line; its second sphere is an ammo/stock mechanic (rechargeRate present, 'stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2'), and the charges persist without a preceding cast, unlike a true recast window (cf. Riven Broken Wings: 'If Riven does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown').

But this repo's own documented vocabulary is the loose one: docs/math-foundations.md Sec 1.1 - 'an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress'. Under that definition, 'recast' = a subsequent cast of the same ability on the shared timeline, which is exactly what the Q2 stocked-charge cast is.
The caveat therefore concerns the NAME of the field, not its value: on the field's own terms the pointer must be 'Q', and no reading of the source data makes '<absent>' or any other slot correct.

Ability recasts are scheduled on **one shared timeline** (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). With `c_i` the effective cooldown of ability `i`, the cast epochs of a solo ability are `0, c_i, 2c_i, ...`

residual_risk: The field's exact contract lives in src/ and was deliberately not read. If `recast_of` is defined narrowly as 'strict wiki-labelled Recast', the Syndra Q2 tag is a naming category error (Syndra's only strict Recast is W's Force of Will throw) - but even then the correction would be to rename/remove the field convention, not to change the value, since the source data fixes Dark Sphere (Q) as the sole possible parent of the Q2 stocked-charge cast.
